brief: Delta: a broad 24h bounce (BTC +1.52%, ETH +2.07%, HYPE +4.86%, ZEC +7.21%) while 7d returns stay negative for BTC, ETH and SOL. Funding is back at the neutral 10.95 on most markets, so XMR's crowded-long premise from last run is gone (its setup closed at +1.04R). HL total OI is up (z30 2.17) into FOMC at 18:00 UTC, so the base case is a sharp two-way reaction. New: DOGE htf_pullback short (low conviction) from the one tripwire hit. Open: ZEC long triggered, ENA short triggered, both premises intact. Watch WLD, AAVE reclaim setups and VVV (HL funding 33.56 points over CEX). Wrong if DOGE holds above its 1d SMA20. Gaps: HL 429 on AAVE funding, FARTCOIN funding, LINK/INJ/ARB candles; OI changes are null (2 snapshots).
